items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And come to think of it I think I'm -- I think a guy named of -- oh, what was his name -- not Bubba Myer (PHONETIC) -- there was a guy before Bubba Myer (PHONETIC) What was his name?

ctx.x: he played sweet horn. He was one of my idols. Just like Bobbie Hackett, they seemed to be the same type of guys you know -- in the way that they were trained -- the solos they played. You know -- they played pretty, you know. And I liked Joe Smith very much.
And come to think of it I think I'm -- I think a guy named of -- oh, what was his name -- not Bubba Myer (PHONETIC) -- there was a guy before Bubba Myer (PHONETIC) What was his name?
